daily.title: Time and Place of Supply Under GST: Provisions, Rules and Practical Illustrations
daily.summary: Understand GST time and place of supply rules, forward and reverse charge, tax rate changes, imports, exports and intermediary services. A question that arises in the mind of every GST-registered supplier is: When does the tax liability arise? This question is answered by the time and place of supply rules under the GST Act, 2017. The liability to pay GST arises at the time of supply. The applicable provisions are contained in Sections 12 (goods), 13 (services), and 14 (change in the rate of tax) of the CGST Act, 2017 .

daily.title: Evolution of India-Mauritius DTAA: From Treaty Origins to Contemporary Landscape of Anti-Abuse Frameworks
daily.summary: Evolution of India-Mauritius DTAA, 2016 and 2024 protocols, capital gains taxation, Tiger Global judgment, TRC and Principal Purpose Test. India and Mauritius first signed and enforced the treaty on 1 April, 1983. It’s provisions for capital gains provided taxing rights on such transactions to the country of residence of the seller instead of the source country (majorly India). Since Mauritius did not tax capital gains, the sellers did not have to pay any tax in either country. This benefit along with other favorable conditions made Mauritius a leading route for Foreign Direct Investments (FDI) and portfolio investments into India.

daily.title: Senior Citizen Tax Rates For Tax Year 2026-27: With Example on Different Income Levels
daily.summary: Senior citizens in India can pay tax under two systems: the New Regime and the Old Regime.For Tax Year 2026–27, the New Regime has the same slabs for ever This guide compares the two in simple steps, so you can pick the one that saves you more tax.
